statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent shortness of breath consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated.
The service corresponds to CPT code 93247.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan.
